719-2638-3510-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-2638-3510-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

2586-3197-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat
2586-3197-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

967-3809-4247-7087-7824.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5256-6094.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5016-6780-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
5016-6780-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Spitemare indestructible using Your Temple Is Under Attack.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5016-6780-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

457-777-1792-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-777-1792-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Foundry Inspector.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-4772-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

5342-7276.manaNeeded: {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable if Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield
5342-7276.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block Dark Leo & Shredder if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
Dark Leo & Shredder doesn't have summoning sickness if it's on the battlefield.
You control at least four Ninjas.
5342-7276.description:
Declare Dark Leo & Shredder as an attacker if it's on the battlefield, or another creature you control otherwise.
If Dark Leo & Shredder isn't on the battlefield, when the declared creature is unblocked, cast Dark Leo & Shredder either from your hand or from the command zone for its sneak cost by paying {W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable and returning the unblocked attacker to your hand.
Deal combat damage using Dark Leo & Shredder, triggering its second ability, creating a 1/1 Ninja creature token and causing the opponent to lose their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
5342-7276.notes: You must control four Ninjas when Dark Leo & Shredder deals combat damage. Notably, if it isn't on the battlefield, you must control five total Ninjas if the attacker you will be returning is a Ninja.

1753-2033-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1753-2033-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2232-2792-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2034-2232-2792-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

2457-4772-5794-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

222-527-997-2079.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-997-2079.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

774-1671-3470.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

774-3470-3861.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2-3152-5922.notablePrerequisites: Helga has power 4 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
2-3152-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color that can only be spent to cast creature spell with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying its mana cost.
Helga and Chakram Retriever trigger.
Resolve the Helga trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, causing you to untap Helga.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2178-4395-5367.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4395-5367.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1017-1656-4762-5028.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1017-1656-4762-5028.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Arcanis' first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Wizard Class triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

4067-4343-4435.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
4067-4343-4435.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, tapping target creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, causing you to pay {1} to scry 2 and draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-1883-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{U}{U}{U}.
1031-1883-4276.description:
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, targeting Invasion of Arcavios.
Replication Technique's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it, with your copy targeting Invasion of Arcavios.
Resolve your copy of Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Invasion of Arcavios.
When the token Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Turnabout to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the original Replication Technique, creating a token copy of Invasion of Arcavios.
When the token Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Replication Technique to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{U}{U}, you may earn infinite mana, and then target any other permanent using the copy of Replication Technique.

427-3525-4055.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kydele.
You have drawn at least three cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-3525-4055.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

1988-2034-3192.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Ulasht.
Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1988-2034-3192.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Repeat.

2247-3263-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Teferi has at least six loyalty counters on it.
2247-3263-4312.description:
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Teferi.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

147-961.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Against All Odds.
147-961.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Against All Odds, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Against All Odds, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-4385.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
1636-4385.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
The Sliver enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1624-1745.description:
On the end step before your turn, activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability by paying 1 life, adding {C} that can only be spent to cast spells from your graveyard.
Repeat step 1 until you have exactly one life remaining.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.
